interface.shortDescription: Portable workflows for ChatGPT Web and Codex.
interface.longDescription: Provides 12 reviewed planning, analysis, design, performance, security, and handoff workflows. It works only from conversation context, user-provided files, and enabled connected apps; it never assumes access to a local filesystem, shell, or executable.
interface.defaultPrompt: Select the most specific Personal Skills Core workflow for this request. Work only from conversation context, user-provided files, and enabled connected apps; clearly state when required evidence is unavailable.
